scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:contracts
scripts.check:syntax: node --check agent.js && node --check codex-choice.js && node --check motion-ux.js && node --check plugins.js && node --check reactbits-micro.js && find api codex-runner -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r -n1 node --check
scripts.test:contracts: set -e; for test in tests/*_test.py; do python3 "$test"; done; for test in tests/*_test.mjs tests/test_*.js; do [ -e "$test" ] || continue; node "$test"; done
